overview.description: Bank of Montreal - MicroSectors -3× Short Communication Services (XLC) ETNs due July 31, 2046 is an exchange traded note launched by Bank of Montreal. The note seeks to track 3x the daily performance of the State Street Communication Services Select Sector SPDR ETF, total return. The index represents the public equity markets of the United States. It use short strategy and comprises of the stocks of companies operating in the communication services sectors. The index comprises of the growth and value stocks of large-cap companies. The ETN will mature on July 31, 2046. Bank of Montreal - MicroSectors -3× Short Communication Services (XLC) ETNs due July 31, 2046 was formed on September 11, 2026 and is domiciled in Canada.
